title: Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled starting in November 2026
body:
Starting in November 2026, Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

A Genie Code task runs your prompt autonomously as part of a job. It can read upstream task outputs and call tools as needed, and it returns a link to the resulting Genie Code chat with its response.

See [Genie Code task for jobs](/aws/en/jobs/tasks/genie-code).
